messages:
maria_support: FYI customer ACME hit a 403 'permission denied' in the org console after we ran a SCIM group merge earlier tonight. Ticket #INC-12345. Repro steps below.

maria_support: Steps to repro (from their user):
1) Sign in -> switch to 'Acme Corp' org
2) Console returns 403 on any org-scoped endpoint and UI shows 'You don't have permission'
3) Same user can hit hosted API keys fine, only console/org actions blocked

maria_support: Curl they used (sanitized):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer user_session_token" 
  https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/orgs/ACME/dashboard
```

maria_support: Response (from browser devtools):
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
content-type: application/json
x-request-id: req_acme_9c3
{ "error": "permission denied", "code": 403 }
```

maria_support: From logs: role_bindings for that user show an entry with external_id: "scim-group-OLD-123" which no longer exists after merge, so user ended up with an 'orphaned' binding.

tom_platform: Can you paste the raw role_binding row and the delta from the SCIM merge job? also did the customer hit any UI errors before the merge? :thinking:

maria_support: Paste below (redacted):
```
user_id: u-9876
org_id: org-acme
role: project_admin
external_id: scim-group-OLD-123
last_seen: 2026-02-18T02:05:12Z
```

maria_support: SCIM merge job log snippet: "merged group scim-group-OLD-123 -> scim-group-NEW-456; removed legacy external_id entries". Looks like during the merge we deleted the OLD external_id without migrating role_bindings that referenced it.

jess_idp: ack. sounds like role_bindings lost link to external identity. can you run an idp:resync for that org (admin-only job) and attach output? i can follow up with a fix to keep bindings when groups are merged.

maria_support: kicked off idp resync at 02:10 UTC. deploy-bot: job started message came back.

deploy-bot: idp-resync-job(org-acme) started by maria_support (job_id: resync-2026-1747777777)

alex_sre: FYI if resync doesn't recreate the external_id mapping the console check will still reject because authz resolves bindings by external_id. Might need a manual patch on the role_binding to point to the NEW id.

maria_support: resync finished (02:12 UTC). Output: "3 users remapped, 0 bindings auto-migrated, 1 orphaned_role_binding flagged: rb-555"

jess_idp: thanks — confirms migration job didn't touch role_bindings. we flagged rb-555 as orphaned and left it to ops.

tom_platform: can you share rb-555 row? if it's safe we can run a short remediation script to remap external_id -> scim-group-NEW-456. need approval from security.

maria_support: rb-555: "user u-9876, role: project_admin, external_id: scim-group-OLD-123"

jess_idp: I approve a scoped fix to rebind orphaned entries when there's a single clear target. security OK as long as we log and add a dry-run flag. :white_check_mark:

alex_sre: i'll prepare a small DB migration script (dry-run first). tom, can you review quickly?

tom_platform: reviewing now. Also recommend we add a guard in the SCIM merge job to carry over role_bindings by matching old->new mapping. will add a follow-up ticket.

maria_support: ran migration in dry-run mode: 1 binding would be remapped (rb-555 -> scim-group-NEW-456). No other changes.

deploy-bot: migration-dryrun(resync-fix-1747777777) completed: remap_count=1

maria_support: ran migration (live) at 02:18 UTC. user can now access org console. Customer confirmed via support call.

maria_support: Closing loop with ACME, informed them root cause (SCIM merge deleted legacy external_id refs) and that we've remapped orphaned bindings + added follow-up to change merge job.

tom_platform: filing infra task to add guard and test for role_binding preservation. tagging eng-idp and eng-platform.

jess_idp: will add postmortem notes and a unit test for merge path.

alex_sre: recommend we also add an alert if resync job reports orphaned bindings > 0 so we catch this earlier.

maria_support: created alerting ticket and added it to the incident. summary: temporary manual remap applied, resync job updated to log orphaned bindings, long-term: change merge to migrate role_bindings. :thumbsup:
